name: Juan Corvinos
title: President, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Drives growth, commercial strategy, and strategic partnerships across HE CALA with deep experience in hotel development, owner relations, and project management.
bio: Previously at Hilton in Latin America and the Caribbean—oversaw development for all Hilton brands, signing 350+ management and franchise agreements and helping grow the CALA portfolio from 63 to 280+ open hotels. Senior leadership sponsor for Hilton’s Hispanic LatinX ERG; international assignments in Malaysia, Barcelona, London, and Washington, D.C. Cornell Hotel Management certificate.

name: Michael Register
title: Chief Development Officer, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Sources new opportunities and builds owner relationships across resort, lifestyle, and urban assets. Brings Trust Hospitality, Highgate, and global development experience to CALA.
bio: Instrumental in sourcing and negotiating management contracts across the region. Trust portfolio spanned Mexico, DR, Colombia, Brazil, Jamaica, Costa Rica, Panama, Anguilla, Aruba, Curaçao, Bahamas, Turks & Caicos, Trinidad, and St. Lucia. Earlier: Nikki Beach worldwide openings; co-founder of software company AAT; international corporate and business law in Brazil and Miami. Cornell Law; Vanderbilt (Latin American Studies, magna cum laude).

name: Marilia Pergola
title: VP of Operations, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Operational strategy across the expanding CALA portfolio—revenue management, brand compliance, financial performance, and pre-opening excellence with strong owner relationships.
bio: 20+ years in hospitality including 8+ years at Marriott International. Managed 100+ full-service and select-service hotels in CALA; achieved 86% owner satisfaction in 2023. Led City Express integration and Starwood/Marriott loyalty merger work. Launched the first Aloft in Latin America (Bogotá) in 60 days.

name: Martin Larralde
title: VP of Finance, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Financial operations, performance management, and owner-facing finance leadership across full-service and resort properties in the region.
bio: 10+ years progressive hospitality finance: cross-border planning, capital management, and forecasting. Most recently at Oak View Group (Mexico); prior Hilton roles across Latin America and the Caribbean including Shared Services, Curaçao, The Bahamas, and Mexico City. Fluent English and Spanish.

name: Maria del Pilar Garcia
title: Senior Director of IT Systems, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Strategic technology planning—IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and system integrations for openings, conversions, and operational efficiency.
bio: Nearly two decades in hospitality technology. Led technology for Hilton All-Inclusive and luxury launches including Opera, per-person pricing, wearables, and related platforms. Based in Miami; focused on scalable infrastructure and innovation across the CALA portfolio.

name: Margie Aristy Mai
title: Senior Director of Sales, Caribbean and Latin America
summary: Regional sales performance with emphasis on OTA and travel partner relationships in Mexico and the Dominican Republic, property takeovers, and brand conversions.
bio: 10+ years in hospitality sales. Known for collaborative leadership, scalable sales systems, and distribution frameworks that support sustainable growth. Bilingual English and Spanish.

name: Rodrigo Cuello
title: Sr. Director of Human Resources, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Recruitment, training, employee relations, compensation, benefits, and organizational development—with deep openings and rebranding experience across LATAM.
bio: Extensive experience hiring executive and large-scale hospitality teams at Hyatt and Hilton. Multicultural LATAM background with a psychology degree. Based in Cancún; focuses on smooth openings and organizational health. Bilingual Spanish and English.

name: Mariana Gonzalez
title: Director - Shared Services and Ops Finance, Caribbean & Latin America
summary: Shared services and ops finance in Mexico—back-office operations supporting CALA scale with disciplined financial performance.
bio: Previously at Hilton overseeing shared services for Mexico and the Dominican Republic—from focused service to 1,000+ key luxury all-inclusive properties. Hotel management graduate and lifelong hotelier. Bilingual Spanish and English. Based in Ciudad de México.
